headword: {個人事業主|こじんじぎょうぬし}

definitions.gloss: sole proprietor; self-employed person; individual business owner
definitions.explanation: a person who operates a business on their own without forming a corporation; a legal/tax classification in Japan

examples.japanese: {個人事業主|こじんじぎょうぬし}として{開業届|かいぎょうとどけ}を{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I filed a business registration as a sole proprietor.

examples.japanese: {個人事業主|こじんじぎょうぬし}は{毎年|まいとし}{確定申告|かくていしんこく}をする{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: Sole proprietors need to file a tax return every year.

examples.japanese: フリーランスのデザイナーとして{働|はたら}いているが、{税務上|ぜいむじょう}は{個人事業主|こじんじぎょうぬし}に{分類|ぶんるい}される。
examples.english: I work as a freelance designer, but for tax purposes I'm classified as a sole proprietor.

notes:
Composed of {個人|こじん} (individual) + {事業|じぎょう} (business) + {主|ぬし} (owner; master). This is the official tax and legal term for someone who runs a business without incorporating. In Japan, becoming a {個人事業主|こじんじぎょうぬし} requires filing a {開業届|かいぎょうとどけ} (business opening notification) with the {税務署|ぜいむしょ} (tax office).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個人事業主|こじんじぎょうぬし}として{開業|かいぎょう}する: to start a business as a sole proprietor
- {個人事業主|こじんじぎょうぬし}の{確定申告|かくていしんこく}: sole proprietor's tax return
- {個人事業主|こじんじぎょうぬし}{向|む}け: aimed at sole proprietors
- {個人事業主|こじんじぎょうぬし}から{法人化|ほうじんか}する: to incorporate from sole proprietorship

SIMILAR WORDS:
- フリーランス: freelancer — emphasizes the work style; many freelancers are legally {個人事業主|こじんじぎょうぬし}
- {自営業|じえいぎょう}: self-employment — broader term covering anyone who runs their own business
- {法人|ほうじん}: corporation — an incorporated entity, as opposed to an individual business owner
